description: Pruning-oriented stage taxonomy for MolClaw-KG relation-aware pair pruning and deterministic alternative edge generation.

target_identifier_acquisition.definition: Retrieve target identifiers, metadata, or raw sequence records.

target_structure_acquisition.definition: Retrieve experimentally resolved or database structures.

protein_sequence_qc_descriptor.definition: Validate or characterize protein sequences before structure prediction/design.

target_structure_prediction.definition: Predict protein or complex structures from sequence.

structure_format_conversion.definition: Convert predicted or complex structures into downstream structural file formats.

structure_chain_extraction.definition: Extract structural chains or chain sequences from structure files.

structure_rebuild_repair.definition: Repair, rebuild, protonate, or complete protein structures.

structure_sidechain_completion.definition: Complete or repack side chains from backbone structures.

receptor_docking_format_preparation.definition: Convert prepared receptor structures into docking-specific receptor formats.

protein_structure_qc_descriptor.definition: Compute PDB-level geometry, quality, composition, or structural descriptors.

ligand_identity_acquisition.definition: Retrieve SMILES or compound identity from external chemistry databases.

ligand_smiles_validation.definition: Validate SMILES strings before generation, property calculation, preparation, or docking.

ligand_file_preparation_conversion.definition: Convert valid SMILES or molecule lists into downstream molecular file formats.

ligand_descriptor_property_scoring.definition: Compute molecular descriptors, ADMET, drug-likeness, similarity, fragment, or phenotypic scores.

ligand_generation_template_acquisition.definition: Retrieve or prepare predefined peptide/template information for generators.

ligand_de_novo_or_template_generation.definition: Generate new molecules, linkers, R-groups, scaffolds, or peptides from templates/warheads/scaffolds.

ligand_analog_optimization.definition: Optimize or expand molecules from existing seed molecules.

binding_site_detection.definition: Detect, rank, or define candidate binding pockets from protein structures.

pose_generation_docking.definition: Generate protein-ligand, protein-protein, peptide-protein, or complex docking poses.

docking_pose_pocket_extraction_for_resco.definition: Extract pockets or prepare pocket-level inputs from docking results for rescoring.

affinity_prediction_rescoring_screening.definition: Predict affinity, rescore poses, rank candidates, or perform virtual screening.

end_to_end_docking_scoring_pipeline.definition: One-click or wrapper pipelines that internally combine several docking/scoring steps.

static_interaction_analysis_validation.definition: Analyze static protein-ligand, peptide-protein, or protein-protein complexes or docking poses.

trajectory_interaction_analysis.definition: Analyze interactions from MD trajectories or dynamic complex ensembles.

simulation_system_preparation.definition: Prepare protein-only or protein-ligand/protein-protein systems for MD or free-energy calculation.

simulation_or_sampling_execution.definition: Run MD, coarse-grained simulation, conformational sampling, or relaxation workflows.

simulation_ensemble_extraction.definition: Extract representative structures or frames from simulation/sampling outputs.

free_energy_calculation.definition: Compute binding free energy using MM/PBSA, MM/GBSA, or related methods.

free_energy_result_analysis.definition: Analyze and summarize free-energy calculation outputs.

residue_numbering_mapping.definition: Map residue numbering between UniProt, PDB, predicted structures, and tool-internal schemes.

protein_backbone_or_complex_generation.definition: Generate protein backbones, complexes, symmetric assemblies, or binder candidates.

protein_sequence_design.definition: Design or score sequences conditioned on protein structures/backbones.

protein_design_repair_mutation_evaluatio.definition: Repair, mutate, score, or evaluate designed proteins/interfaces.

file_import_decoding.definition: Decode external/base64 content into server-side files.

visualization_rendering.definition: Generate protein, molecule, or interaction visualization artifacts.

file_export_encoding.definition: Encode server-side artifacts for transfer or reporting.
